claims.claim: Brought news from Vera Cruz, to 1866-07-27
claims.citation: New York Herald, 10 August 1866, p. 1, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
The steamship Alliance, Captain Perkins, from Vera
Cruz on July 27, has arrived at New Orleans. We are
indebted to the purser for the prompt mailing of our
Vera Cruz despatches.
Our dates from the city of Mexico are to the 20th, and
from Vera Cruz to the 27th ult.
